confidence_notes: Meal, coffee, and beer estimates use Numbeo Zagreb aggregates from May–June 2026, near the July window. Cocktail is estimated at about 3.3 times the local draft-beer price and wine at about 1.5 times, due to limited direct price data. Accommodation is a holistic July estimate with greater seasonal uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are Zagreb-specific; accommodation is modeled from Zagreb’s inland European capital profile and July travel season.
